name: Capital Hunt 2.0
short_description: Capital Hunt 2.0 – General Category is a startup pitching platform under graVITas'26, jointly organized by the Institution's Innovation Council (IIC), VIT Alumni Association (VITAA), and graVITas. The category provides a platform for promising student-led startups to showcase their ideas before an expert panel and gain valuable exposure, feedback, and opportunities within the entrepreneurial ecosystem. Applications will be evaluated and shortlisted by the IIC, and only teams shortlisted by IIC and subsequently registered through the official graVITas'26 registration portal will be eligible to participate in the pitching event.
tagline: Where Ideas Meet Opportunity

name: DevJams'26
short_description: DevJams'26 is GDG's flagship beginner-friendly 48-hour hackathon that brings together student developers, designers, and innovators to transform ideas into impactful solutions. Participants work in teams, receive mentorship from industry professionals, take part in fun ice-breaker activities, and showcase their projects before an expert judging panel while competing for exciting prizes.
tagline: Wham Bam Let’s DevJam!

name: Architecture in Motion: The Transformable Model Challenge
short_description: Architecture in Motion: The Transformable Model Challenge is an innovative architectural model-making competition that explores adaptive and responsive architecture through physical prototypes. The event encourages participants to move beyond conventional static models and develop transformable architectural systems that demonstrate flexibility, movement and adaptability.
tagline: Architectural Model Making Competition + Interactive Exhibition

name: Star Wars: New Horizons
short_description: Build. Battle. Become the Empire. A Star Wars-themed Chemical Engineering showdown — 14 teams construct factories, unlock weapons, and battle across 8 rounds.
tagline: "Build. Battle. Become the Empire."

name: Hands on robotics
short_description: Dive into the exciting world of robotics with this interactive 2-day workshop! The experience begins with a solid grounding in microcontrollers and communication protocols, applying these concepts through beginner-friendly projects using the ESP32. The participants will create and code their custom webpage with an interactive User-Interface. Everything comes together by building a 2-wheel-drive robot from scratch and linking it directly to a smartphone. By the end of this workshop, participants will have built a fully functional robot that responds in real time to smartphone tilt-to-steer controls.
tagline: Build, code, and command your own t in just 2 days!

name: WE Hack 5.0
short_description: WE Hack 5.0 is a 36-hour hackathon where engineers from every branch come together to build real solutions to real problems. Not just software. Not just CS. Mechanical, civil, biomedical, electrical, electronics, AI and more, all in one room, building together. 200+ participants. 4 cross-domain themes. One shot to build something that actually matters. You get 36 hours of non-stop building, 24/7 mentor access to keep you unblocked, and a seat at an exclusive networking dinner with industry professionals. The teams that show up ready to build walk away with more than a prize. Spots are limited. Build with us.
tagline: Where WE build what’s next.

name: Rovaris
venue: Sarojini Naidu Gallery, Era Sezhiyan Auditorium
short_description: Ever wondered what it feels like to be part of a Mars mission? ROVARIS lets you step into the world of space technology through an exciting blend of learning, strategy, and hands-on rover building. Day 1 kicks off with an expert-led rover workshop followed by software-based mission challenges where strategy and teamwork are key. Day 2 brings the experience to life as participants build and operate their own rover on a Mars-inspired terrain, with each team getting to keep the rover they assemble. Learn, compete, build, and explore—all in one unforgettable experience. No prior knowledge required—just bring your curiosity and your team!
tagline: Build the Rover. Conquer the Terrain.

name: HackXpertise 3.0
club: IEEE - TECHNOLOGY AND ENGINEERING MANAGEMENT SOCIETY ( IEEE-TEMS)
short_description: HackXpertise is a flagship event organized by the IEEE TEMS Chapter, VIT Vellore, during graVITas. It is a 2 day event with a Figma workshop on the first day and a hackathon on the second day.
tagline: Innovation Begins with Expertise.

name: Jumanji: The Outbreak
short_description: An ancient pathogen has escaped from the Temple of the Jaguar, and the only cure is the mythical "Eye of the Jaguar." Teams of 3 to 5 players must take on the roles of iconic characters and race against time. Solve cryptic clues, collect secret letters, and unlock the final challenge before the deadly infection consumes you forever.
tagline: Find the Eye of the Jaguar or become part of the jungle forever!

name: Robosprint
short_description: This hands-on workshop introduces students to the fundamentals of electronics through the process of building real-world hardware projects from scratch. Participants will learn core electronic concepts, understand the logic behind hardware and software integration, write the code that powers their projects, and assemble a fully functional prototype. The workshop also includes an introduction to 3D printing, enabling students to design and fabricate custom components, providing a complete end-to-end product development experience.
tagline: Build. Code. Create. From First Circuit to Functional Prototype.

name: HackVerse 2026
club: School of Computer Science and Engineering
short_description: HackVerse 2026 is a 24-hour national-level Capture The Flag (CTF) competition focused on practical cybersecurity skills. Participants compete in teams of two and solve 60 challenges across Web Security, Cryptography, Reverse Engineering, Digital Forensics, Binary Exploitation, OSINT, Steganography, and other security domains. The competition encourages ethical hacking, teamwork, analytical thinking, and responsible security practices.
tagline: Solve Cyber Challenges. Capture Flags. Lead the Board.

name: Through Their Eyes
short_description: Ready to see the world differently? Step into the shoes of a visually impaired person and take on exciting blindfolded challenges that will test your senses in ways you never imagined. Finish by creating your own beaded bracelet—and take home a unique keepsake along with a whole new perspective. Think you can do it?
tagline: Experience a world without sight

name: Code2Create 7.0
short_description:
Code2Create 7.0 is ACM-VIT's legacy 48-hour national hackathon and one of VIT's largest student-led technical events. Built around the idea of turning ""what if"" into ""what's next,"" it brings together hundreds of passionate developers, designers, and innovators from leading institutions across India to collaborate, compete, and create technology that addresses real-world challenges. With carefully curated problem statements, dedicated mentorship from industry experts, multiple evaluation rounds, and a competitive final showcase, Code2Create provides participants with an immersive platform to transform bold ideas into impactful solutions while learning, networking, and pushing the boundaries of innovation.
Don't just code for the vibes, Code2Create!
tagline: Don’t just code for the vibes, Code2Create.

name: F1 Championship
short_description: An intense three-day F1 racing tournament featuring 200 drivers competing through qualifiers, a wildcard race, semi-finals, and a grand final. Participants will battle for progression across multiple races, with the fastest drivers advancing through each stage. From 10 qualifier races to the final 20-driver championship race, the tournament tests speed, consistency, and racecraft to determine the  ultimate F1 champion
tagline: Race Hard. Become the Champion

name: LayerZero
short_description: LayerZero – Beneath Every Device is a two-day hands-on PCB design workshop that takes participants from the fundamentals of electronic circuit design to creating industry-ready printed circuit boards. Through guided sessions, practical exercises, and a final mini-project, participants will learn schematic design, PCB layout, routing, design verification, and manufacturing workflows using professional EDA tools.
tagline: Beneath Every Device

name: QuantumVerse
short_description: QuantumVerse is a hands-on workshop on Quantum Dot-Based Digital Circuit Design led by industry experts from InfinosTech. Participants will gain a strong foundation in Quantum-dot Cellular Automata (QCA), design and simulate digital circuits using industry-relevant tools, and explore optimization techniques for enhanced circuit performance. The workshop concludes with an engaging design challenge, enabling participants to apply their knowledge and gain practical exposure to next-generation semiconductor technologies.
tagline: Quantum dots, real circuits

name: Auction to Action 3.0
short_description: Auction to Action is a business simulation event where participants bid on virtual companies through strategic auctions and then solve real-world business challenges to maximize their investments and outperform competing teams.
tagline: Think. Bid. Execute.

name: EcoVention
short_description: EcoVention challenges individuals or teams of two to develop a sustainable product -furniture, an acoustic panel, or any other building/interior element of their choice - using sustainable materials and a sustainable design approach, intended for use in a residential setup or a retail showroom (participant's choice).
tagline: Sustainable Product Design Challenge

name: HackGrid
venue: Bhagat Singh Gallery, Homi Baba Gallery
short_description: HackGrid ’26 is a pre-fest hackathon for Gravitas, VIT’s annual technical fest, designed to simulate the experience of building a real startup. Participants build SaaS solutions for real-world problems while balancing technology, creativity, and business strategy.
tagline: BID.BUILD.COMPETE

name: VIT RUNFEST 2026 WOMEN
short_description: VIT RunFest 2026 is a competitive marathon event designed to promote fitness, endurance, discipline, and sportsmanship among students. Participants will compete individually on a designated route, with rankings determined by completion time. The event aims to provide an exciting and challenging running experience while encouraging students to push their limits and embrace a healthy lifestyle.
tagline: Run. Endure. Conquer.

name: VIT RUNFEST 2026 MEN
short_description: VIT RunFest 2026 is a competitive marathon event designed to promote fitness, endurance, discipline, and sportsmanship among students. Participants will compete individually on a designated route, with rankings determined by completion time. The event aims to provide an exciting and challenging running experience while encouraging students to push their limits and embrace a healthy lifestyle.
tagline: Run. Endure. Conquer.

name: Robo Pong
short_description: Robo Pong is an interactive robotics workshop that introduces participants to the application of robotics and automation in sports through a robot-assisted table tennis setup. Participants will learn about the working principles of robotic systems, including sensors, motors, control mechanisms, and automated ball-return systems, followed by a hands-on session where they can experience and operate the robotic table tennis system.
tagline: Play. Learn. Experience Robotics.

name: Hydro Clash (Women)
short_description: Hydro Clash is an exciting 6v6 Water Polo Championship that combines swimming, teamwork, strategy, endurance, and competitive gameplay. Teams compete in the water through fast-paced passing, attacking movements, defensive plays, and goal-scoring opportunities, creating an energetic and engaging sporting experience for both participants and spectators.
tagline: Kick Off. Dominate. Conquer

name: SourceSprint
short_description: SourceSprint is IEEE-VIT's flagship open source workshop and coding contest where participants learn Git and GitHub, contribute to real-world repositories, solve assigned issues, earn points, and compete on a leaderboard. Build practical development skills while experiencing collaborative software development through open source.
tagline: Commit.Create.Conquer

name: Clueminati 4.0
short_description: Ragnarök is back, and this time the World Tree itself is breaking. Teams will be torn apart mid-briefing and flung into different realms: some hunting clues across campus, others battling through virtual worlds. Keys, relics, and weapons must be found separately before both halves can reunite. Will you gather what it takes to mend Yggdrasil before the realms collapse? Step in... if you dare.
tagline: Scattered across realms, sworn to reunite.

name: CASHFLOW 5.0
short_description: The Bulls and Bears Club proudly presents Cashflow 5.0! Returning for a massive 5th edition, our legacy finance board game immerses you in property, stocks, and entrepreneurship. But this time, the stakes are higher with an all- new thrilling Finathon! Test your wealth-building strategies, generate passive income, and escape the rat race. Are you ready to outsmart the market and claim your ultimate financial freedom?
tagline: Roll the Dice, Read the Market and Escape the Rat Race

name: AgriVate
club: VIT School of Agricultural Innovations and Advanced Learning
short_description: AgriVate – Cultivating Tomorrow's Technology is a 36-hour hackathon that brings together innovators to create technology-driven solutions for contemporary agricultural challenges. Covering precision farming, smart automation, and climate-resilient practices, participants will develop impactful prototypes that promote sustainable agriculture and contribute to the future of global food security.
tagline: "Cultivating Tomorrow's Technology🌱"

name: Blitz Battle Arena – Online Swiss Chess Championship
short_description: Blitz Battle Arena is an online Swiss-system blitz chess tournament hosted on Lichess. Players compete in fast-paced 3+2 (or your preferred time control) games against opponents of similar scores over multiple rounds. The event promotes strategic thinking, sportsmanship, and competitive esports among chess enthusiasts while providing a fair Swiss pairing system that allows every participant to play throughout the tournament.
tagline: Every Move Counts. Every Second Matters.

name: Flip The Script
short_description: A fast-paced 2D flipbook workshop and competition.
tagline: See you on the Flip Side!

name: Autodesk Fusion x Standards: Industry Hackathon
short_description: The Autodesk Fusion × Standards: Industry Hackathon is a two-day multidisciplinary engineering competition where students solve real-world industrial challenges using Autodesk Fusion 360, AI-assisted workflows, engineering principles, and BIS standards. Participants collaborate in teams to design innovative, sustainable, and practical solutions while showcasing technical excellence, creativity, and industry-ready problem-solving skills.
tagline: Innovate. Design. Standardize. Build the Future Together.

name: MicroMouse
tagline: Explore. Adapt. Accelerate.

name: Aerodominator
short_description: Aerodominator is a flagship fixed-wing aircraft design and flight competition at graVITas 2026, organised by the Society Of Automotive Engineering(SAE-VIT). Student teams are challenged to conceptualise, design, build, a radio-controlled (RC) fixed-wing aircraft from scratch — demonstrating engineering ingenuity, aerodynamic know-how, and hands-on fabrication skill.
tagline: Design.Build.Fly.

name: Engineer's Trial
short_description: Engineer's Trial is an automotive-themed engineering competition that challenges participants through technical quizzes, fault diagnosis, design thinking, and strategic decision-making. Teams compete across multiple rounds to earn Nuts & Bolts, the event currency, by applying engineering principles, creativity, and teamwork. The journey culminates in an exciting final challenge where only the most resourceful team emerges victorious.
tagline: Think. Build. Solve. Prove You're a Real Engineer.

name: CAPTURE THE FLAG (CTF 4.0)
short_description: Capture The Flag 4.0 (CTF 4.0) is the fourth edition of IEEE ComSoc VIT's flagship team-based tech hunt that combines logical reasoning, real time problem solving, and campus wide strategy. Teams of 7 to 10 members, depending on the total number of registrations, begin with a 15-minute challenge round consisting of 8 rapid fire questions based on technology, general knowledge, apps, and taglines. The time remaining after completing these questions determines the duration available for teams to hide their assigned colored flag across designated areas of the campus, excluding hostels and academic blocks, with assistance from event volunteers.  Once the hiding phase concludes, all teams return to the base point, and on the official signal, the hunt begins. Teams must locate and capture as many opposing flags as possible within the allotted time. This year, CTF 4.0 introduces enhanced gameplay through a dedicated event website featuring centralized tracking, streamlined question management, live leaderboards, and real time progress monitoring, ensuring a smoother and more competitive experience. The team that secures the highest number of flags and completes the final challenge in the shortest time will be crowned the winner.
tagline: CTF4.0: Leave No Flag Behind

name: Antidote Hunt 2.0
short_description: A dangerous pathogen has escaped... and the city is counting on you.  A rogue scientist's experiment has gone horribly wrong, unleashing an unknown pathogen into the city. As elite BioWarriors, your mission is to analyze the clues it left behind, identify the organism using real microbiology and molecular biology techniques, and stop the outbreak before it's too late.
tagline: From Outbreak to Breakthrough

name: Embed Control 7.0
short_description: Get ready for Embed Control 7.0, our flagship 2-day workshop on the versatile ESP32 microcontroller! Enjoy hands-on sessions on embedded fundamentals, sensor interfacing, and real-world applications. Explore Wi-Fi and Bluetooth to build smart IoT and automation solutions. Ideal for beginners and tech enthusiasts!
tagline: Step into the World of Next-Gen Embedded Systems & IoT!

name: Quadcopter
short_description: SAE VIT along with team Rotor FPV presents Quadcopter, a drone building workshop where participants get to build, fly and take away the drone built as a team of 6. Participants will first learn all the fundamentals before working hands-on to build a drone from scratch which you will get to fly and keep for yourself (1 Drone per team).
tagline: Learn . Build . Fly

name: The Last of Us
short_description:
In a world pushed to the brink of collapse, survival isn’t just about making it through it’s about outsmarting the odds.
The Last of Us drops teams into an adrenaline fueled, post-invasion survival scenario where every decision counts. Navigating high stakes checkpoints toward a secure safe zone, your team must pool your collective wits, creativity, and practical problem-solving to overcome the unknown.
Along the way, every solved challenge rewards you with cryptic pieces of a puzzle. Assemble them correctly, and you'll forge a unique physical souvenir proof of your team's resilience and triumph.
Step up, work together, and adapt on the fly. Will your team breach the safe zone, or will you get left behind?
tagline: Keep moving, or join the infected

name: RoboInvest
short_description: RoboInvest is a robotics startup ideathon that challenges participants to transform innovative ideas into promising ventures. Teams identify real-world problems, explore market opportunities, develop robotics-based solutions, and present a compelling business model and long-term vision to a panel of investors. The most promising startups earn virtual investments based on their potential, innovation, and understanding of the market.
tagline: Beyond the Bot. Build the Business.

name: SAE-Drone Racing League (DRL)
short_description: The Drone Racing League (DRL), organized by SAE-VIT as part of Gravitas 2026, is a high-speed FPV drone racing competition designed to test precision, agility, and piloting skills. Featuring a MultiGP-standard race track, the event includes Amateur and Professional categories, free practice, qualifying rounds, and an exciting final race. DRL brings together skilled pilots and technology enthusiasts for a competitive and immersive racing experience.
tagline: Race The Sky

name: Manufacture Your Dream : RC Car Building and Racing
venue: CDMM 103 + CDMM 105, CDMM 103 + CDMM 105, CDMM 103 + CDMM 105
short_description: Manufacture Your Dream is an exciting RC car building and racing event hosted by the Society of Manufacturing Engineers at graVITas 2026. Teams work together to assemble a remote-controlled car from scratch using provided materials and then race it on a custom track. The fastest combined time wins, and the top three teams receive cash prizes.
tagline: Don't just dream it. Build It. Race It.

name: HuntVerse
short_description: HUNTVERSE is an IoT-powered campus adventure where participants build their own ESP32-based smart scanners and use them to discover hidden wireless digital creatures. Combining embedded systems, Bluetooth communication, and real-time competition, the event transforms engineering concepts into an exciting hands-on tech hunt.
tagline: Explore. Innovate. Conquer - A Quest Beyond Limits

name: Build the Brain of an IoT Device: A Hands-On FPGA Workshop
short_description: Build the Brain of an IoT Device is a beginner-friendly hands-on FPGA workshop designed to introduce students to digital hardware design through live demonstrations and guided implementation. Participants will build the logic behind smart systems such as traffic controllers and digital locks while learning how FPGA technology powers modern IoT applications in industries including automotive, healthcare, telecommunications, and smart cities.
tagline: Logic Today, Smart Tomorrow with FPGA & IoT

name: Battle In Borderland 2.0
short_description: Battle in Borderland 2.0 is a thrilling multi-round team competition that combines logic, technology, strategy, and teamwork. Participants will tackle exciting challenges such as escape-room puzzles, internet navigation, technical brain teasers, and strategic decision-making. Each round tests a different skill, making the event engaging, competitive, and beginner-friendly for all students.
tagline: Every Round is a New Battle

name: Case Study
short_description: Teams analyse a real business problem, develop practical solutions, and present recommendations before a judging panel. The event evaluates analytical thinking, business strategy, teamwork, communication, and decision making under time constraints. Put your strategic acumen to the test through multi-round challenges, high-stakes boardroom presentations, and a surprise crisis twist.
tagline: Decode the case, win the race, and secure your place!

name: Blockchain Unchained: Technology, Trends, and Tomorrow
club: School of Computer Science and Engineering
short_description: “Blockchain Unchained: Technology, Trends, and Tomorrow” is a one-day workshop that introduces participants to blockchain fundamentals, its role in security, real-world applications, and career opportunities. It also helps participants understand how blockchain can address real-world problems and its growing importance in everyday life.
tagline: Blockchain Unchained: Technology, Trends, and  Tomorrow

name: SEASON ZERO 2.0
short_description: Step into Season Zero 2.0, an unforgettable multi-genre adventure designed to push your limits! Face your deepest fears in a terrifying horror escape room to banish an ancient mansion's curse. Defy reality in an mind-bending sci-fi room where split teams must solve puzzles across time. Finally, sprint through buildings in a high-stakes crime hunt to outsmart a killer before time runs out. Three pulse-pounding zones. One ultimate test of courage, brains, and teamwork. Are you ready?
tagline: Where Reality Ends, The Game Begins..

name: The Micro-Habitat: The Micro Living Challenge
short_description: As urban spaces shrink and sustainability becomes crucial, micro-living has evolved from a trend into a necessity and an attempt towards SDG-11 Sustainable cities and communities. Participants are challenged to design a self-contained, single-occupant Tiny Home / Micro-Studio with a maximum footprint of 40 square meters. Participants can assume a hypothetical site of not more than 80 square meters of any shape.

name: Best Management Team
short_description: ARKK - The Rebuild Protocol is the Best Management Team competition of VIT Business School's intercollegiate  management fest Invictus’26 flagship event of gravitas26 . Six rounds. One escalating crisis. Your team makes every call, adapt when the rules change, and defend your final decision live. Simple to understand. Brutal to master. No textbooks.  No jargon. Just your team's ability to lead when it actually matters. Open to all streams and colleges. Come find out what  your team is actually made of.
tagline: Prove you can lead when it matters.

name: YogaVerse
short_description: YOGAVERSE is an AI-powered software development challenge that combines yoga, computer vision, and gamification. Participants build systems that detect yoga poses in real time and evaluate pose accuracy using AI. Teams create engaging platforms where users earn points, maintain streaks, unlock achievements, progress through levels, and compete ,making fitness interactive, rewarding, and fun.
tagline: YOGAVERSE – Where Movement Becomes the Game

name: TAG x FIFA
short_description: Grab your controllers and claim campus bragging rights! Join our 1v1 local EA FC 26 tournament. Face off head-to-head against fellow students in high-stakes, fast-paced matches on the big screen. Registration and slots are limited. Prove you're the absolute best on the pitch—sign up now!
tagline: Kick Off. Dominate. Conquer

name: Purble Place 2.0
short_description: Purble Place is a timed, hands-on cake-decorating competition designed to foster artistic expression, resource management, and creative design among participants. Taking inspiration from the classic digital simulation, the event translates conceptual design into a physical medium.
tagline: Turning Simplicity into Sweet Art

name: The Great Game
short_description:
The Great Game: The Loop of Control 
 is an intense, 3-hour tabletop strategy game built for squads of 4-5. Battling across connected Past, Present, and Future board layers, your team will barter resources on a live trading floor and play time-travel ,sabotage cards to erase rival moves in real-timeline before the entire map collapses!
tagline: "Rewrite the past. Steal the present. Rule the future!"

name: Tote-ally blocked out 3.0
short_description:
"Unleash your inner artist with SPIC MACAY's flagship event, tote-ally blocked out 3.0!
Delve into the world of traditional Rajasthani block printing and create your own uniquely designed totes brimming with vibrance. 
Take home with you your very own creation that you can carry with you everyday!"
tagline: Craft it. Own it. Tote it.

name: Tangled
short_description: Get ready to roll, twist, stitch, and create! 🎨🧶 Tangled is the ultimate creative escape where clay meets crochet in one exciting workshop. Whether you're sculpting adorable clay creations or learning trendy crochet designs, this is your chance to unleash your inner artist, make something uniquely yours, and have an amazing time doing it. No experience needed—just bring your creativity and good vibes!
tagline: One Workshop. Two Crafts. Endless Fun. ✨

name: Battlecode
short_description: BattleCode is a competitive programming event by the IEEE Computer Society Chapter that transforms coding into an exciting tournament. Featuring rank based matchmaking, one versus one coding battles, Elite versus Challenger matchups, live leaderboards, and a thrilling code hacking phase, the event goes beyond traditional programming contests. Participants compete to outsmart opponents, climb the rankings, and defend their position while solving algorithmic challenges. Whether you are taking your first steps into competitive programming or already enjoy coding contests, BattleCode offers an engaging, beginner friendly, and action packed experience.
tagline: Fight. Adapt. Win

name: Drone Soccer
short_description: Drone Soccer is a high-speed aerial duel where two pilots face off inside a netted arena, each commanding a single spherical drone. The objective is simple: pilot your drone through your opponent’s goal ring while defending your own. There are no teammates. No passes. Just you, your drone, and the sky.
tagline: Command your drone. Defend the ring. Rule the skies.

name: Claude code in Action: AI assisted development from idea to deployment
club: School of Computer Science and Engineering
short_description: A hands-on workshop on Ai-assisted software development using claude code .
tagline: Build Smarter .Code Faster . Deploy Better

name: Aero-crafters
short_description: Dive into the fundamentals of aerospace engineering by learning the science of flight, aircraft design, and aerodynamics. Build and assemble your own aircraft under expert guidance while gaining hands-on engineering experience.
tagline: Where Aircraft Take Shape.

name: HuntScape
short_description: HuntScape is an immersive cybersecurity-inspired adventure that combines the thrill of a  treasure hunt with the challenge of an escape room. Participants work in teams to solve a  series of puzzles involving encryption, decryption, encoding, decoding, logical reasoning,  and hidden clues. Teams must race against the clock to uncover clues, navigate through multiple checkpoints,  and complete the final objective. The event is designed to test problem-solving ability,  teamwork, technical aptitude, and strategic thinking in a fun and engaging environment. The event will be conducted in multiple time slots throughout the day. The top-performing  teams from each slot will advance to the Grand Finale, where they will compete in an  advanced challenge to determine the overall winners.
tagline: Every clue matters, every second counts

name: One-Day Hands-on Workshop on Full Stack Application Development with Generative AI
club: School of Computer Science Engineering and Information Systems
short_description: one-day hands-on workshop on building modern full-stack web applications and integrating Generative AI using APIs, LLMs, and prompt engineering. Participants will develop an AI-powered mini project through practical coding sessions.
tagline: Active participation in the workshop sessions. Completion of the hands-on coding exercises. Successful integration of Generative AI/LLM APIs into the application. Functionality and performance of the mini project. Understanding of full-stack development concepts and API integration. Quality of the final AI-powered application.

name: EnergyThon
short_description: Energython is an intensive hackathon and idea-thon organized by the Association of Energy Engineers (AEE) VIT Vellore for graVITas 2026. Designed to tackle pressing real-world challenges in the energy sector, teams of 1 to 5 members will ideate, design, and pitch innovative solutions across renewable energy integration, smart grids, energy efficiency, and sustainable urban mobility. Gear up to disrupt the current, demonstrate your technical creativity, and compete for a share of the ₹15,000 prize pool!
tagline: Sparking the Next Wave of Clean Tech

name: Escape Room
short_description: Escape Room is an immersive, team-based adventure where participants enter specially designed themed rooms inspired by Stranger Things and Harry Potter. Solve thrilling puzzles, decode hidden clues, crack mysteries, and unlock challenges to escape before time runs out. Test your logic, teamwork, communication, and decision-making under pressure in a fun, fast-paced, and competitive experience filled with excitement and adventure.
tagline: Crack the Clues. Conquer the Clock.

name: PCBify 2.0
short_description: Are you curious about how electronic devices are built, or how complex circuits come to life on compact green boards? Here’s your chance to explore the fascinating world of Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs) through an immersive, beginner-friendly workshop. Over the span of two days, participants will gain both theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience in PCB design. Starting from the fundamentals of electronic circuits and schematic design, the workshop will guide students through design software tools, component placement, routing techniques, and industry standards. By the end of the workshop, attendees will have designed their very own PCB, bridging the gap between conceptual circuits and real-world applications.
tagline: Powered by Ojas Racing

name: Aqua Beats (MEN)
short_description: Aqua Zumba is an exciting fitness and wellness activity that combines the energetic movements of Zumba with the natural resistance of water. Conducted in a swimming pool, the session allows participants to perform rhythmic exercises, stretches, and dance-based movements while reducing stress on the joints and muscles. By integrating elements of aerobics, dance, flexibility training, and mindfulness, Aqua Zumba offers a holistic experience that enhances physical fitness, improves coordination, and promotes mental relaxation.
tagline: Move, Splash, Repeat

name: AGENT-A-THON 2026
club: School of Computer Science and Engineering
short_description: AGENT-A-THON 2026 is a 24-hour hackathon dedicated to Agentic AI, where students, developers, and innovators collaborate to build autonomous AI solutions addressing real-world problems. Participants will design intelligent agents, develop functional prototypes, and present innovative solutions to expert judges while competing for exciting prizes. The event encourages creativity, teamwork, technical excellence, and industry engagement, fostering the next generation of AI innovators.
tagline: Where Autonomous Intelligence Meets Innovation

name: Celestial Dive 5.0
short_description: Celestial Dive 5.0 is a journey beyond Earth. Spend an unforgettable night exploring the cosmos through powerful telescopes, uncovering the mysteries of the universe through engaging astronomy sessions and experiencing immersive planetariums that bring space to life. Enhanced by a carefully crafted moonlit ambiance, every moment is designed to inspire wonder, curiosity and a deeper connection with the universe.
tagline: One Night - Infinite Wonders.

name: Game Of Tones
short_description: Games of Tones is an interactive competition where science, sustainability, and Westerosi spirit collide. Your journey begins with an Oathtaking to place your team into an iconic Game of Thrones house. Craft eco-friendly paints from scratch, then clash in a Rapid Fire Round to win rare pigments and special additives like waterproofing or magnetic properties. Once tested, paint your house sigil on canvas, design a custom wooden keychain, and take home a vial of your handcrafted paint. When you play the Game of Tones, you either paint or you dye!
tagline: All must Paint! All must Dye!

name: Heartz & Waves
short_description: Heartz & Waves is a 36-hour workshop + hackathon where hardware, code & signal processing come together to solve real biomedical problems. No biomedical background needed. Learn the basics of biomedical sensing & signal processing, then design, code, debug and build using live physiological data. From sensors and embedded systems to real-time signal processing to turn noisy data into meaningful insights. Every team takes home their own biomedical sensor kit.
tagline: Decode the Rhythm of Life: 36 Hours of Bio-Sensors & DSP.

name: Techno Treasure Hunt
short_description: The Great Treasure Hunt is a fun team game where clues, riddles and puzzles are used at various points around the campus to guide the teams to the treasure. It tests the abilities of teamwork, logical thinking, observation and time management as teams compete to discover the hidden treasure. The first team to successfully complete all the challenges in the shortest period of time will be the winner.
tagline: NA

name: Let's Glow, Picasso!
short_description: Get ready for a fun-filled painting experience where creativity meets teamwork! In pairs, participants will take turns painting while blindfolded, guided by their partner through words, actions, and gestures. Using vibrant acrylic and glow-in-the-dark paints, create a unique artwork that comes to life under UV light. Trust your partner, embrace the chaos, and let your creativity glow. Best of all, you'll get to take home your glowing masterpiece as a memorable keepsake!
tagline: Let Your Creativity Glow.

name: Ctrl + Alt + Confuse
short_description: Ctrl + Alt + Confuse is a fun-filled strategy event where teams tackle dynamic challenges with constantly changing rules, hidden objectives, and unexpected twists. Success depends on adaptability, teamwork, and quick decision-making under pressure.
tagline: Think Fast. Adapt Faster. Expect Absolute Chaos.

name: Yellow Tape 5.0
short_description: A crime has been committed, and the truth lies hidden within the evidence. Step into the shoes of a forensic investigator, analyze the clues, reconstruct the sequence of events, and identify the culprit before time runs out. Every detail matters, and every decision brings you closer to solving the case.
tagline: Everyone's a suspect. No one's safe.

name: Solar Heist
short_description: Solar Heist is a story-driven mystery adventure where participants become Energy Detectives on a mission to recover a stolen clean-energy technology. Teams solve puzzles, decode clues, uncover hidden evidence, and complete interactive challenges inspired by renewable energy concepts. Combining teamwork, strategy, observation, and logical thinking, the event delivers an immersive experience that is both entertaining and educational.
tagline: Steal Back The Future

name: Glowchella
short_description: GLOWCHELLA is a thrilling Squid Game inspired chemical engineering survival challenge where only the fastest and most creative teams survive. Face a series of exciting hands-on challenges involving glowing polymers, fragrance formulation, reaction optimization, and precision-based games. Every round tests your teamwork, strategy, and scientific skills as you battle for exclusive rewards, unforgettable souvenirs, and the ultimate title of Glowchella Champion.
tagline: "Risk it.Reveal it"

name: VANTAGE – Visionary Assembly for New Technology, Advocacy, and Global Ethics
short_description: VANTAGE(Visionary Assembly for New Technology, Advocacy, and Global Ethics)  is a one-day flagship event by the Debate Society that brings together technology, policy, and public speaking. It features a keynote by an industry or policy leader, followed by a Turncoat Speaking Competition where participants argue both sides of AI and technology governance motions. Through critical thinking and persuasive speaking, VANTAGE challenges participants to engage with the most pressing technological issues of our time.
tagline: Ethos Pathos Logos

name: Power and Precision Challenge
short_description: An interactive TechnoSports football challenge where participants test their shot power and accuracy using a ball-speed measurement system and an electronic target goal. Each participant gets five attempts to score points by hitting different target zones, while their shot speed is also recorded. The event combines football with simple sports technology to create a competitive and engaging experience for participants and spectators.
tagline: Power. Precision. Performance.

name: Exploring AI, IoT and Cybersecurity for the Digital Era
club: School of Computer Science Engineering and Information Systems
short_description: Exploring AI, IoT and Cybersecurity for the Digital Era is a hands-on workshop introducing students to three transformative technologies shaping the future. Through live demonstrations, practical examples, and interactive sessions, participants will explore AI, smart IoT systems, cybersecurity, ethical hacking, digital forensics, and AI-driven cyber defense. The workshop also highlights career opportunities, certifications, internships, research, and innovation pathways for building a future-ready technology career.
tagline: Explore. Innovate. Secure. Shape the Digital Future.

name: Soul Scribe
short_description: This event is designed to evaluate participants’ creativity, narrative development and adaptability in storytelling. The event is divided into 2 rounds.
tagline: A lore that demands your soul

name: Padakkalam 2.0
short_description: Padakkalam 2.0 is an exciting cultural-tech fest where creativity meets innovation! Across two dynamic rounds, teams will test their quick thinking in Parayathe Parayam through improvised dramas based on AI prompts, and dive into Anveshipin Kandethuvin, an action-packed online campus treasure hunt filled with clues, puzzles, and prizes. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure of drama, mystery, and discovery!
tagline: Where logic meets limelight

name: The Hexagon Protocol
short_description: Think you've got what it takes to solve the unknown? The Hexagon Protocol invites you to embark on a thrilling adventure where every stage reveals new clues, fresh challenges, and unexpected twists. Work with your team to think critically, make strategic decisions, and adapt to an ever-changing game. Every choice shapes your journey, and every challenge brings you closer to uncovering the mystery. Gather your team, embrace the adventure, and discover if you can crack the protocol.
tagline: Decode the Unknown. Conquer the Challenge.

name: Humanity Through Lens
short_description: Humanity Through Lens is an NSS photography competition that encourages participants to capture powerful moments of kindness, community service, environmental conservation, and social responsibility. Through compelling photographs and meaningful captions, participants showcase real-life stories that inspire positive change. The event aims to promote empathy, creativity, and social awareness while highlighting the impact of small actions in building a better society.
tagline: Every Picture Tells a Story of Change

name: Smart Cobots: AI in Modern Industrial Automation
short_description: This one-day technical workshop introduces participants to AI driven Collaborative Robots (Cobots) and their applications in Industry 4.0. Through expert sessions and live demonstrations, attendees will explore how Artificial Intelligence, IoT, and cloud technologies are transforming industrial automation. The workshop equips students with practical insights into intelligent manufacturing, human robot collaboration, and future career opportunities in smart industries.
tagline: Empowering the Future of Manufacturing with AI-Driven Collaborative Robotics.

name: OPERATION BELLA CIAO: THE MATHEMATICAL HEIST
short_description: The legendary mastermind The Professor has planned the biggest heist in history. A secret mathematical key containing billions in digital assets is locked inside the Royal Mathematical Mint. Teams become members of the heist crew — Tokyo, Berlin, Nairobi, Denver, Rio, Helsinki, and Lisbon — and must break through five high-security mathematical barriers before the authorities trace their location. Mission Structure 🏦 Phase 1 – Professor’s Cipher 🎭 Phase 2 – Inspector’s Interrogation 💰 Phase 3 – Berlin’s Vault Lock 🎲 Phase 4 – Tokyo’s Risk Matrix 🌐 Phase 5 – Rio’s Network Breach 🔓 Final Heist – The Mint Vault Each completed phase reveals a piece of The Professor’s Master Code. Teams must combine all collected fragments to unlock the Royal Mint’s final vault and secure the stolen treasure before the countdown reaches zero.
tagline: OPERATION BELLA CIAO: THE MATHEMATICAL HEIST

name: Modelling Minds 2.0
short_description: Modelling Minds 2.0 goes beyond theoretical knowledge by encouraging participants to develop practical, scalable, and innovative AI solutions under time constraints. Whether you're exploring Machine Learning for the first time or building advanced AI agents, this event provides an exciting platform to learn, compete, and showcase your problem-solving abilities.
tagline: From Data to Decisions, From Agents to Action.

name: Access Denied
club: STUDENTS ASSOCIATION OF BIO-ENGINEERING SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (SABEST)
short_description: Access denied is an immersive biotechnology escape room event that combines puzzles, quizzes, riddles,  and analytical problems, drawing from diverse disciplines within biotechnology. It  encourages participants to view familiar concepts from entirely new perspectives, requiring  logic, creativity, and critical thinking. However, there’s a catch, every challenge solved  unlocks the next, turning the experience into a high-stakes escape room where only those  who keep up can progress.
tagline: Crack the Code, Unlock the Truth

name: CookOff 11
short_description: GraVITas' longest-running competitive coding event is back for its 11th edition! With its all-new format, CookOff 11 is set to push veterans and rising stars alike to achieve algorithmic feats they thought impossible. CookOff 11 is a high-stakes arena of logic, speed, and structural elegance. We invite you to be a part of its legacy.
tagline: Learn. Code. Simplify.

name: Raaz-e-Qatl
short_description: Raaz-e-Qatl is an immersive murder mystery where teams become detectives, analyze clues, uncover hidden connections, and race against time to identify the culprit. With twists, red herrings, and shocking revelations at every turn, only the sharpest minds will unravel the truth.
tagline: Yeh hai gumraahon ka rasta, Muskaanein jhooti hai

name: The Lost Manuscript
short_description: Days before the release of his final manuscript, a celebrated horror novelist vanishes without a trace. In his study lies an unfinished novel about an author haunted by the certainty that someone is plotting his murder. As teams unlock chapters through cryptic puzzles and hidden clues, the fiction begins to echo reality with unsettling precision. Was the manuscript merely a story or a desperate warning left behind before the author disappeared?
tagline: Follow the trail. Finish the tale. Face the truth.

name: ABSOLUTE CINEMA
short_description: Absolute Cinema is a workshop-style event where a simulated reactor meltdown has trapped teams of 3-4 participants in a time loop across iconic cinematic universes. Acting as elite chemical engineers, teams must use science, quick thinking, and teamwork to complete a series of unique STEM and chemistry experiments inspired by popular movies and shows like Stranger Things, Star Wars, and Jurassic Park. The ultimate goal is to solve these high-stakes laboratory challenges to repair the fractured timeline and escape the multiverse before time runs out.
tagline: Lights.Camera.Action

name: Insight for Impact
short_description: Insight for Impact empowers you to turn raw data into compelling visuals, uncover meaningful insights, and master the art of data storytelling to drive smarter decisions and real-world impact.
tagline: From Raw Data to Powerful Insights

name: Right! A Tune
short_description: Right A Tune! is VIT Music Club’s flagship 48-hour overnight music production hackathon where participants collaborate to compose, record, produce, and mix original songs. Featuring expert-led workshops, creative challenges, networking opportunities, and a live showcase, the event brings together musicians and producers to learn, innovate, and compete for exciting cash prizes.
tagline: When the clock strikes creativity!

name: Capital Hunt 2.0 Fresh MInds
short_description:
Capital Hunt 2.0 – FreshMinds

Capital Hunt 2.0 – FreshMinds is a startup ideation and pitching platform under graVITas'26, created for fresh minds across VIT to showcase innovative and original ideas. Participants get the opportunity to present new concepts, receive expert evaluation and mentorship, and take their first step towards transforming an idea into an impactful venture.

The event invites innovative ideas across three key themes: AI & Machine Learning (AI & ML), Med-Tech, and Internet of Things (IoT). Participants can develop and present solutions addressing real-world challenges within these domains.

The platform encourages students to explore entrepreneurship, refine their ideas with expert guidance, and connect innovation with real-world opportunities. The Top 3 teams in each theme will be recognized for their innovative potential, with selected teams having the opportunity to receive Product Development Funding of up to ₹50,000, subject to the applicable evaluation, approval, and funding process.

Capital Hunt 2.0 – FreshMinds is where fresh ideas take their first step towards becoming impactful ventures.
tagline: Where Ideas Meet Opportunity

name: Building Integrated Photovoltaic (BIPV) and Rail/Road Integrated Photovoltaic (RIPV) technologies
tagline: Innovating Solar PV for Sustainable Infrastructure

name: Cicada 2067
short_description: Not just a competition, but the beginning of a mystery far greater than reality. "It's not possible." "No. It's necessary." The future sent a message. Against all odds, it found you. Fragments of that transmission have surfaced across time- hidden in clues, buried in secrets, waiting to be discovered. Piece by piece, you'll uncover what spans beyond the known. The weight of the future is entrusted in your capabilities and presence of mind. A race against time. A journey beyond the end. A story larger than life. Some stories are told. Others are found. This is your chance to live one. The message survived. Can you?
tagline: Across the Time. Beyond the Known.

name: THE COSMOS PROTOCOL
short_description: Something came back from the mission that wasn't supposed to be alive. Now the colony is failing and a crew member is down. The Cosmos Protocol is a 2-day computational biology hackathon where you either decode an unknown alien-origin organism from raw gene sequences, or design a computational antibody to save an infected crew member. Day 1 you investigate. Day 2 every team converges on the same crisis and defends their answer. No wet lab. No coding required. No prior experience needed. Just science under pressure.
tagline: Discovery has Consequences

name: Machine Design with Fusion 360
short_description: Ready to build machines that actually move and think together? The Machine Design Workshop is an intensive, two-day deep dive into intermediate CAD, swarm RoboVITics, and virtual prototyping. Go beyond basic tutorials—master parametric 3D modeling, functional assemblies, and cinematic animations in Autodesk Fusion 360. Then, step into the future of simulation by dropping your designs into Webots to test multi-t swarm dynamics, real-world physics, and collective motion before hitting production. Transform theoretical engineering into autonomous, tested reality. Design smart. Test virtually. Build better.
tagline: From Sketch to Swarm: Design, Simulate, Deploy.

name: The Architectural Ideology Charette
short_description: Partcipants must deconstruct its socio-economic impact of the era and the architects work through two core deliverables: a 3-Minute Abstract Short Film capturing human kinetics, lighting, and spatial scale, and a Simple Abstract Physical Model that serves as a three-dimensional manifestation of how that era's ideology organizes or divides society.
tagline: Contemporary Architectural ideology competition

name: RUN BEYOND LIMIT
short_description: Run Beyond Limits is an engaging marathon workshop that combines physical endurance, fitness awareness, and practical knowledge about running. Participants will learn about warm-up techniques, running posture, pacing, hydration, injury prevention, and endurancebuilding strategies before participating in a guided running activity. The workshop aims to promote fitness, discipline, healthy lifestyles, and awareness about safe running practices among students.
tagline: Run. Endure. Conquer.

name: Survival Showdown
short_description: Survival Showdown is an immersive escape room event themed around an abandoned hospital where teams of 3–5 members race against time to solve puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and complete challenging tasks. Designed to test teamwork, logical reasoning, communication, and decision-making under pressure, the event rewards the team that successfully escapes in the shortest time while following all game rules and overcoming thrilling challenges.
tagline: The Hospital was abandoned. The secrets weren't

name: Regenesis
short_description: Regenesis is a dystopian-themed ideathon that challenges participants to tackle complex global crises in a post-apocalyptic world. Working in teams, participants will analyze scenario-based problem statements and develop innovative, scientifically grounded, and sustainable solutions to rebuild civilization. Success will depend on creativity, critical thinking, and the ability to transform bold ideas into practical innovations.
tagline: The End is only the Beginning

name: Bad Idea Billionaires 2.0
short_description: Tech Edition challenges participants to transform the most absurd, impractical, and technically flawed technology concepts into convincing unicorn startup pitches. Armed with technical jargon, innovation frameworks, and persuasive storytelling, teams must sell ideas that should never work—but somehow do. The crazier the concept, the greater the challenge of making judges believe it's the next breakthrough in technology.
tagline: Innovative the impossible. Pitch the ridiculous.

name: TAG x BGMI
short_description: 🔥 Drop. Loot. Survive. Conquer.The ultimate campus BGMI showdown is here! Fight your way through the intense Group Stages to secure your spot in the Grand Finals, where the leaderboard resets and every squad gets a fresh chance at glory. Earn crucial finish points and survival points, outplay every lobby, and prove you have what it takes to claim the title, "Champions of the Campus". 🏆⚔️
tagline: Rising from the ashes

name: Project Renaissance
club: Spanish Literary Association & French Literary Association
short_description: Project Renaissance is an immersive, beginner-friendly kingdom-themed innovation challenge that brings together strategists, creators, and problem-solvers to transform historical issues into inventive solutions. Acting as the elite task force, participants embark on a thrilling treasure hunt to uncover hidden kingdom secrets, forge their strategies during a high-stakes ideathon and bring their projects to life before defending their solutions in the final review phase in front of a royal council, all while competing for ultimate prizes  at the end.
tagline: Reviving Civilizations Through Innovation.

name: Think Tank Sessions
short_description: Think Tank Sessions is an innovation-focused platform that brings together students, faculty, researchers, and industry professionals to explore ideas in new product development. The session will feature idea presentations, panel and thematic discussions, brainstorming, and collaboration on research, intellectual property, and commercialization, encouraging interdisciplinary collaboration and transforming promising ideas into impactful products and ventures.
tagline: Building innovation platforms for new product development

name: FaultLine
short_description: FaultLine is a software engineering competition where participants first build the most intentionally broken application they can, then swap codebases to diagnose, redesign, and transform another team's disaster into a clean, functional solution. It challenges creativity, debugging, architecture, and problem-solving skills in a unique two-phase format.
tagline: Break it. Swap it. Fix it

name: JUNKYARD GENESIS
short_description: Junkyard Genesis is a sustainability driven art competition where creativity meets conscious innovation. Participants will transform discarded electronic waste into meaningful works of art, proving that obsolete technology still holds limitless creative potential. By embracing the principles of Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle, this event encourages participants to rethink waste, promote environmental responsibility, and inspire a future where sustainability and artistic expression go hand in hand.
tagline: Every broken wire tells a new story.

name: Aerovate 3.0
venue: VOC Gallery - II, CS Hall, Men's Outdoor Stadium
short_description: Aerovate 3.0 is a two-day hands-on rocketry workshop that introduces participants to the fundamentals of aerospace engineering. Through interactive sessions, participants will learn about aerodynamics, rocket stability, and propulsion before designing, building, and launching their own model rockets. The event offers a practical engineering experience, taking participants through the complete journey from concept and design to a successful launch.
tagline: Simulate. Construct. Launch.

name: Global Skills for Future Managers
short_description: Global Skills for Future Managers – graVITas 2026 “Leading Across Borders, Cultures, and Technology” is a full-day, team-based workshop for MBA students, tentatively scheduled for 11 September 2026. It focuses on preparing future managers for an AI-driven global business environment through practical learning and competitions. � Global_Skills_for_Future_Managers_graVITas (2).pdf The event includes: AI & Digital Skills for managers AI-assisted, data-driven decision making AI Prompt Challenge to solve real business problems Strategic thinking and decision making International Business Expansion Case Study Global Manager Challenge involving negotiation, cultural communication, AI problem-solving, and supply-chain situations � � Global_Skills_for_Future_Managers_graVITas (2).pdf Global_Skills_for_Future_Managers_graVITas (2).pdf Overall, the event aims to develop AI proficiency, critical thinking, problem-solving, strategic decision-making, collaboration, and global management skills needed by future managers.
tagline: “Leading Across Borders, Cultures, and Technology”

name: Hackbattle
short_description: HackBattle is a dynamic 36-hour hackathon where innovators, creators, and problem solvers come together to code, collaborate, and compete. This overnight coding marathon is a fast paced journey of turning ideas into reality, tackling real world challenges, and building impactful solutions that push creativity and technical skill to the next level. Alongside the competition, participants will enjoy inspiring sessions from industry leaders, offering expert insights, practical guidance, and valuable networking. More than just an event, HackBattle is a vibrant celebration of innovation, teamwork, and the unstoppable energy of technology.
tagline: Hack it till you make it

name: MyoSync
club: IEEE ENGINEERING IN MEDICINE & BIOLOGY SOCIETY (IEEE-EMBS)
short_description: Explore PCB design and get hands on experience with designing your very own PCB for a biomedical device which can be fabricated and gets students a boost in advancing their circuit design skills which come in handy for big projects. Combining with biomedical device theory and designing their PCB they can understand how to choose components; the floor planning and 3D model of their work.
tagline: Muscles meet PCB: Sync the body to the machine

name: Operation Root Cause
short_description: Operation Root Cause is a technical treasure hunt where teams investigate a crashed prototype by solving manufacturing and material-related challenges across seven field stations. Teams of 3–5 members race across campus, analyze evidence, collect physical clues, scan QR codes, and tackle surprise system failures. The fastest team to identify the root cause and complete the mission wins the competition.
tagline: Race. Investigate. Solve. Save the Prototype.

name: Dream Team 8.0
short_description:
Dream Team 8.0 is an IPL-style auction simulation where participants take on the role of franchise owners and compete to build the strongest cricket squad within a fixed budget. Through strategic bidding, resource management, and player evaluation, teams must assemble a balanced squad while navigating competitive auction dynamics and unique challenges. The event combines cricket knowledge, analytical thinking, and decision-making in an engaging franchise-management experience
Compete for exciting cash prizes, showcase your auctioning skills, and prove you have what it takes to build the ultimate Dream Team!
tagline: Buy the Best . Beat the Rest

name: DRONE RUSH
short_description: Drone Rush Workshop is a hands-on engineering experience designed to introduce  participants to the fundamentals of drone design, assembly, electronics, and flight control.  Participants will begin by exploring the principles of drone physics, quadrotor kinematics, and  component functionality through an interactive learning session and quiz. Working in teams,  students will assemble a functional quadcopter from scratch by preparing the frame, mounting  motors, soldering electronic components, and integrating an ESP32-based flight control  system. The workshop will also cover software calibration, motor-propeller configuration,  troubleshooting techniques, and flight testing. The event culminates in an exciting flight  challenge where teams demonstrate their drone's stability, hovering capability, and landing  precision. Participants will also gain insights into advanced drone technologies, firmware  development, and future enhancements, making this workshop an engaging blend of  mechanical design, electronics, programming, and practical aerospace engineering.
tagline: Innovation at full Throttle

name: Data Alchemy 4.0
short_description: Data Alchemy is an immersive, hands-on workshop that explores the rapidly evolving world of AI agents. Participants will move beyond traditional chatbots to build intelligent systems capable of autonomously completing tasks. Through a practical, code-first approach, attendees will create a fully functional AI agent while learning the core concepts of agentic AI.
tagline: Build the Future, One Agent at a Time

name: Sensored Beyond X
short_description:
SENSORED returns as TEC’s iconic Gravitas event, continuing a legacy of 11 years of hands-on innovation and technical exploration. This 18-hour immersive experience brings together technology enthusiasts to explore sensors and IoT through a 10-hour hands-on workshop and an 8-hour hackathon.

Participants will learn sensor fundamentals, interfacing, and real-world applications before transforming their ideas into innovative sensor-based solutions. Registration is individual, while teams of 3–4 participants will be formed for the hackathon to encourage collaboration and creativity. Participants will also get to take their completed projects home as a valuable hands-on takeaway.
tagline: Unbox Innovation, Unlock Possibilities.

name: AERIAL YOGA
short_description: Aerial Yoga is a unique fitness and wellness activity that combines the principles of traditional yoga with the support of a specially designed fabric hammock suspended from the ceiling. The hammock serves as a prop that assists participants in performing yoga postures, stretches, and balance exercises with greater ease while reducing strain on the joints and spine. By integrating elements of yoga, Pilates, flexibility training, and mindfulness, aerial yoga offers a holistic experience that enhances physical strength, improves flexibility, and promotes mental relaxation
tagline: Where Fitness Meets Flight

name: Hydro Clash (Men)
short_description: Hydro Clash is an exciting 6v6 Water Polo Championship that combines swimming, teamwork, strategy, endurance, and competitive gameplay. Teams compete in the water through fast-paced passing, attacking movements, defensive plays, and goal-scoring opportunities, creating an energetic and engaging sporting experience for both participants and spectators.
tagline: Kick Off. Dominate. Conquer

name: Truss Force
short_description: TrussForce is a hands-on structural engineering event where participants will learn the complete workflow of surveying, modelling, loading, and analysing a real canopy roof structure. Participants will first conduct a real-time survey and measurement of the physical model, understand its geometry, members, and supports, and then recreate the same structure in STAAD.Pro.
tagline: Decode to Build

name: Buildonomics
club: School of Computer Science and Engineering
short_description: Buildonomics is a first-of-its-kind two-phase competition at GraVITas 2026 that connects business strategy with hands-on innovation. Teams go from boardroom thinking to building real solutions — all in one event.
tagline: Outthink. Outbuild. Outlast.

name: GameSmith
short_description: An interactive workshop on Mobile game development in Unity, one of the world's most popular game development engines, where participants will be introduced to the fundamentals of mobile game development. The workshop will cover core concepts such as scene creation, Game Objects, scripting with C#, physics, UI design, and building a playable mobile game prototype, providing participants with a hands-on understanding of the game development pipeline.
tagline: Unite. Build. Game

name: SENSORA 2.0
short_description: Sensora 2.0 is where the sharpest minds compete to build what's next. Over two intense days, teams go head-to-head in a 36-hour hackathon — backed by expert-led workshops and industry talks that sharpen their edge. Distinguished speakers and judges from top companies mentor participants as ideas become prototypes. Spanning IoT, AI, Healthcare Tech, and Embedded systems, It is the arena where bold ideas are tested and future tech leaders make their mark. Think fast. Build faster. Compete to win.
tagline: Build. Break. Belong. Sensora 2.0 hits different

name: LAUNCHPAD'26
short_description: An overnight startup simulation organised by E-Cell VIT during graVITas, where participants experience the entrepreneurial journey from problem discovery to pitching. Teams compete in a virtual auction to acquire real-world problems across healthcare, fintech, edtech, logistics, and sustainability. They develop startup fundamentals, validate solutions through mandatory surveys and interviews, and present their ideas to judges, completing an intense, realistic startup-building experience within a single overnight session.
tagline: IDEATE. INNOVATE. IMPACT

name: Autodesk Fusion Workshop
short_description: The Autodesk Fusion Workshop is a hands-on technical session designed to introduce students to Autodesk Fusion 360, a leading cloud-based CAD, CAM, and CAE platform. Led by Autodesk experts, the workshop covers 3D modelling, assembly design, simulation, engineering documentation, and real-world industry applications. Participants will gain practical experience with modern product design workflows and develop valuable skills for engineering projects, competitions, and innovation.
tagline: From Concept to Creation with Fusion 360

name: Follow Me: Build a Human Tracking Robot
short_description: A beginner-friendly hands-on workshop where participants build, program, and test a human-following robot. Learn the basics of robotics, sensors, motors, and microcontrollers using a complete electronics kit provided during the session.
tagline: Build, Program, and Test Your Own Human-Following Robot

name: VINHACK
short_description: VINHACK is the flagship 36-hour hackathon organized by VinnovateIT, the technical club behind MessIT and Latch, the campus's favorite apps. Bringing together developers, designers, and innovators, the event challenges participants to solve real-world problems through collaboration, mentorship, technical workshops, and networking with industry professionals.
tagline: Innit to VinnIT

name: Nebula
short_description: Nebula is a beginner-friendly overnight workshop where a team of 5 build CyberDeck, a multifunctional AI companion featuring voice and touch interaction, multiple interactive modes, built-in games, IoT automation, a digital pet, music player, productivity tools, a smart dashboard, BMP180-based environmental sensing, and an e-reader mode. No prior experience is required. Learn, build, innovate, and take your creation home!
tagline: Craft intelligence, ignite innovation, and bring your companion to life.

name: Stock War
short_description: The market is unpredictable. Your moves shouldn’t be. Step into STOCK WARS—where breaking news, bold decisions, and market instincts collide. Read the signal. Make your move. Rule the market.
tagline: Trade. Strategize. Conquer

name: Code Cortex 3.0
short_description: Code Cortex 3.0 is a 36-hour AI/ML hackathon open to all students. Choose from curated tracks spanning finance, medicine, Drone Tech and Aviation and Security each built around a real dataset and problem space. While allowing you to explore your own idea through the Open Innovation track. Build something that works, explain what it does, and show what you learned. No prior experience needed. Just build something you want to see exist.
tagline: 36 Hours. One Idea. Zero Limits.

name: Aerovision 2.0
short_description: Ever looked at a plane and wondered how it actually stays up there? AeroVision 2.0 is where you find out -  and then design one yourself. No prior aerospace knowledge needed, just show up curious. You'll go from aerodynamics 101 to hands-on with XFLR5 and Fusion 360, then put it all to the test in an overnight ideathon where your team designs, analyses, and pitches an original aircraft concept. It's the perfect first step into aerospace — real tools, real learning, real prizes (including a SolidWorks license) waiting at the finish line.
tagline: Where Ideas Take Flight - Design, Simulate, Soar.

name: Dungeons and Data Structures
short_description: Step into a world of fantasy, mystery, and adventure at our Dungeons & Dragons event!...
tagline: To Those Who Seek Glory!

name: Alice in Borderland
club: International Association of Automation and Robotics In Civil (IAARC@VIT)
short_description: Enter the Borderland, where every game tests a different side of your strength, intelligence, teamwork, and strategy. Inspired by Alice in Borderland, teams will battle through four thrilling arenas, collect the suits, and race toward victory. Expect unexpected twists, intense challenges, and moments where every decision matters. Gather your team, step into the game, and prove you have what it takes to conquer the Borderland.
tagline: Four Suits. One Chance. No Way Back.

name: Social Transformer
short_description: Social Transformer is a business innovation competition where participants solve real-world social  challenges using entrepreneurial thinking, technology, policy, and sustainable business models.  Unlike a typical case study, teams progress from understanding a problem to designing, testing, and  pitching a scalable solution.
tagline: Think. Solve. Transform.

name: Med-o-Poly
club: IEEE ENGINEERING IN MEDICINE & BIOLOGY SOCIETY (IEEE-EMBS)
short_description: Step into the shoes of a hospital administrator in Med-o-Poly, an exciting biomedical engineering-themed board game inspired by Monopoly! Compete to build the most advanced hospital by investing in cutting-edge medical equipment, expanding specialized departments and upgrading healthcare technologies. Every decision shapes your hospital's success as you navigate real-world healthcare challenges while outsmarting your opponents. Med-o-Poly transforms learning into an engaging competition, encouraging participants to develop critical thinking, resource management, and decision-making skills in a healthcare setting.

name: Knot & Strand
short_description: Short Description In Knot and Strand, efficiency is an illusion and every choice leaves a mark. Teams step into a controlled trial of resource allocation and calculated risk, where blind bids, hidden hazards, and blueprint assembly dictate who advances. With no element of chance, your carried-over decisions will either build your passage or seal your fate. Long Description Nothing in Knot and Strand happens by accident. Designed as a multi-stage arena of pure strategy, participants enter a unified space to test their capacity for foresight, resource management, and composure under pressure. With zero reliance on luck, your team’s survival across three escalating phases depends entirely on what you spend, what you risk, and what you leave behind.  * Round 1: First Light – The trial begins in silence. Teams are handed cryptic blueprints and kits polluted with deceptive decoys. You must filter the noise and assemble the core structure to claim initial advantages for the journey ahead because early mistakes will follow you.  * Round 2: Chiral Network – The map opens, but the path is shrouded. Teams place sealed bids to secure scarce delivery contracts before the terrain turns against them. Once routes are locked, hidden hazard zones reveal themselves forcing teams to surrender resources or decipher silent puzzles to keep moving.  * Round 3: One Last Mile – Only those who managed their assets wisely reach the final stretch. No fresh supplies are granted; you must survive on what you have preserved. With all hazards exposed and a single high-value objective on the line, a live auction forces a final, transparent gamble to determine who emerges victorious.
tagline: Every Decision Shapes the Outcome
